question_text: When you create an Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases data source without specifying a custom chunking strategy, what is the default chunking configuration applied?
explanation: Bedrock Knowledge Bases applies a default of 300 tokens per chunk with 20% overlap when no custom strategy is configured. The other values do not match the AWS-documented defaults. (Related exam fact: the chunking strategy cannot be changed after the data source is created.)
source_topic: Bedrock Knowledge Bases default chunking 300 tokens / 20% overlap

question_text: After creating a Bedrock Knowledge Bases data source with a specific chunking strategy, a developer needs to change the chunk size. What must they do?

options.text: Delete and recreate the data source with the new chunking strategy, then resync
Edit the chunking configuration on the existing data source and resync
Change the embedding model to trigger rechunking
Adjust the chunk size in the console with no other action

explanation: The chunking strategy is immutable once a data source is created — there is no edit option. To change it you must delete the data source, recreate it with the desired chunking configuration, and resync the documents. The embedding model does not control chunking, and the console does not permit editing chunk size on an existing data source.
source_topic: Bedrock KB chunking strategy is immutable after creation
